text: A TLC value written as an interval, low..high, reads as the set of integers from low to high wherever a value can appear in a trace, as TLC prints a set it built from a range: 1..1 is {1} and 1..0 is empty (#777). An interval of more than 65,536 integers fails with a message saying so. ask3d#4's ratified model keeps such a set in a variable, and the gate couldn't read its counterexamples.
